_comment: Default vehicle configurations for EcoRoute Optimizer. Load factor multiplies consumption (1.0 = base unladen/standard load).

petrol_hatchback.name: Petrol Hatchback (e.g. Maruti Swift)
petrol_hatchback.notes: ARAI-certified test cycle. Real-world urban driving is typically 15-20% lower.

diesel_suv.name: Diesel SUV (e.g. Mahindra Scorpio)
diesel_suv.notes: ARAI-certified. Diesel has higher tailpipe CO2 per litre (2.68 vs 2.31 kg/L) but higher volumetric fuel economy.

electric_sedan.name: Electric Sedan (e.g. Tata Nexon EV)
electric_sedan.notes: Energy consumption rate from ARAI/manufacturer spec. SoC 80% represents typical daily departure charge.
